normalized_excerpts.circle_q3_2026: Circle Q3 2026 Form 10-Q: average USDC circulation $73.264B, period-end $73.879B; USDC on-chain transaction volume $13.9T, up 49% year over year; total revenue and reserve income $865M; distribution costs to Coinbase $331.3M in Q3 and $986.6M over nine months. normalized_excerpts.circle_reserves_2026: Circle Q3 2026 Form 10-Q, September 30 reserve composition: Circle Reserve Fund $62.467B (approximately 84% of USDC reserves), cash $9.732B, outside U.S. Treasury securities $1.758B. normalized_excerpts.arc_mainnet: Circle, 2026-09-16: Arc public mainnet launched as an open Layer 1 for financial markets, real-time money movement and agentic activity. Circle says it launched with more than 100 applications and more than 100 institutional/ecosystem builders. Network fees are paid in USDC; Arc uses a permissioned validator set. Circle says USDC represented 98.8% of agent-driven transaction volume in its agent stack. ARC genesis minted 10B tokens on 2026-09-14; ARC is designed for future PoS security, utility and governance, while fees remain payable in USDC. Circle says the mint is not a commitment to publicly launch ARC and the PoA-to-PoS transition is planned for 2027.
normalized_excerpts.arc_validators: Circle, 2026-08-05 founding validator announcement: Arc cohort includes BlackRock, DTCC, Galaxy, Global Payments, ICE, Mastercard, MoneyGram, SBI Group, Standard Chartered, Sumitomo Corporation and Visa, alongside Circle. Circle says more than 100 builders were already on private mainnet. Validator participation is an Arc relationship, not XRPL validation or XRP ownership.
normalized_excerpts.sbi_arc: SBI Holdings, 2026-05-12: SBI Holdings says it participated in Circle's ARC Token presale through a consolidated subsidiary. The announcement cites Circle's then-stated total presale of $222M. SBI does not disclose its own allocation or the participating subsidiary's identity. This is an ARC investment, not an XRP purchase.
normalized_excerpts.circle_arc_10q: Circle Q3 2026 Form 10-Q: during Q2 2026 Circle entered token purchase agreements with institutional investors for 807.5M ARC tokens at $0.30, aggregate gross proceeds approximately $242.2M. $181.8M recognized as revenue and the balance deferred at September 30. Circle completed ARC genesis mint of 10B tokens on September 14, 2026; a portion relating to presale was distributed or held in escrow. Presale purchasers have lock-up and repayment rights in specified circumstances, including failure to transition to PoS by May 8, 2028. Circle does not commit to a public token launch.
normalized_excerpts.sbi_circle_equity: SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank, 2025-06-09: each acquired $25M of Circle Internet Group shares in its NYSE IPO, $50M combined strategic investment. This is equity in Circle, not XRP.
normalized_excerpts.sbi_startale: SBI Holdings, 2026-03-26: SBI Group agreed through subsidiaries to invest approximately $50M in Startale Group and expected Startale to become an equity-method affiliate. Work includes Strium tokenized-asset infrastructure and JPYSC stablecoin co-development.
normalized_excerpts.jpy_sc: SBI Holdings, 2026-06-24: JPYSC was issued by SBI Shinsei Trust Bank and initially distributed only within SBI VC Trade accounts; Startale co-developed it. Public-chain circulation was deferred pending legal and tax practice clarification. It is a yen stablecoin rail, not XRP.
normalized_excerpts.sbi_smbc: SBI Holdings and SMBC Group, 2026-10-30: capital/business alliance to study stablecoin use cases including JPYSC and conduct research, use-case planning and proof-of-concept work. SMBC agreed to acquire a 5% equity stake in SBI Startale Marketing. This is not a live payment volume disclosure.
normalized_excerpts.open_standard: SBI Holdings and Startale, 2026-10-16: joined Open Standard, a consortium of more than 140 companies including Visa, Stripe, Mastercard, BlackRock and Coinbase, and are exploring interoperability experiments between JPYSC and Open USD (OUSD). This is a proposed proof of concept, not a live settlement volume.
normalized_excerpts.sbi_rlusd: SBI VC Trade and Ripple, 2026-06-24: SBI VC Trade began RLUSD handling in Japan, classifying it under Japanese law as a Type 4 electronic payment instrument. SBI VC Trade is a consolidated SBI Holdings subsidiary. This is a direct RLUSD distribution relationship, not proof that all RLUSD transactions use XRP.
normalized_excerpts.circle_rate_sensitivity: Circle Q3 2026 Form 10-Q interest-rate sensitivity: at a constant USDC circulation balance of $73.9B and constant reserve mix, a 100-basis-point increase in average reserve return rate would increase annualized reserve income by approximately $739M and distribution and transaction costs by approximately $371M; a 100-basis-point decrease would reduce them by the same approximate amounts. Circle states it cannot accurately predict the actual impact on reserve income or costs because USDC circulation and customer behavior are uncertain.
